stories.title: Panama rocked by 2 powerful earthquakes, multiple aftershocks

en.title: Panama rocked by 2 powerful earthquakes, multiple aftershocks
en.summary: Two earthquakes measuring 7.7 and 6.6 magnitude struck Panama on Friday, causing building collapses and triggering evacuations nationwide. The first quake centered in Herrera province was felt across neighboring countries.

en.summary: The European Parliament voted overwhelmingly for a hardened stance toward China, designating it a Russian enabler and citing industrial policy as an existential threat to the EU.

en.title: Port of LA, key US point for China imports, has best-ever quarter despite trade uncertainty

stories.title: Trump says US to get diesel from Russia in stunning bid to ease prices

en.title: Trump says US to get diesel from Russia in stunning bid to ease prices
en.summary: President Trump announced a deal with Russia to supply diesel to the US, marking a significant shift in policy toward Moscow amid the Ukraine conflict. The move aims to address elevated fuel prices before US midterm elections.

en.title: Omani Flydubai co-pilot planned to crash plane into Israeli airport, UAE says
